what: The section is pinned to the top of the screen (card count × screen height), and the cards waiting below rise one per screen of scroll (power1.out) and stack on top of the previous card. Each card is set slightly lower at the top, so only the number row is left showing as they overlap. The photo behind rises -5% and shrinks from 1.05 → 1 over that 4/3 length · If a side scene name (caption) is given, it crossfades .5 each time a card finishes rising (straight line, scrub 1, 4/3 screen per card)

options.per: Scroll used per card (screen heights), default 1
options.back: Back photo range (multiple of the card range), default 4/3
options.from: Minimum window width to turn on (px), default 860 — when narrower, cards simply stack
options.--fx-rise: Distance the card starts pushed down (css variable), default 80vh — Brand is calc(100svh - 18rem)
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Card that rises up — position and overlap are set by the using side’s css (absolute in the same spot, z-index in order)
options.scrub: scrub value, default true — a-bite is 1
options.ease: Curve the card rises on, default GSAP default (power1.out) — Brand D is none
options.fade: Duration of the scene name (caption) change (timeline share), default .5
options.hold: Rest time after the scene name changes, default 0 — Brand uses .5
options.[data-fx-part=caption]: (if present) side text that changes per card — the first text belongs to the first card, and once all cards have risen the previous text disappears and the next one rises

from.where: index.html Projects section (.rl-projects) — original front-page inline (pin · end +=3×innerHeight · y 0 on each li · back photo y -5% scale 1 · +=4×innerHeight)

index.html .act (staggered stack of overlapping photos — the next photo rises in a straight line from 100vh below and covers the last, only the scene name on the right cross-fades at .5, pin +=400% scrub 1). per: 1.333; ease: none; scrub: 1; hold: .5; from: 769

index.js .km-service (two business cards, original [data-top-service]) — the section is pinned below the header strip, and each card rises in a straight line from 120% below (yPercent) over 150% of scroll, stacking in the same cell (grid-area 1/1). The first card also rises from below

index.js .rb-cards (four solution cards, original Index.initializeSolutionCards) — the four cards rise in a straight line one by one from (100lvh − 22.4rem) below and stack, leaving only the title row, with each top edge stepped down 4rem. About one screen per card, the photo inside travels −20% → 0 → −40% and the text is filled line by line (line-fill-scrub).

note: The card overlap positions (top 6.3rem each · height) are a mechanism, so they live in the consuming css. The original has three cards so a fixed length of 3 screens, and the back photo is 4 screens
